name: Isabella Cathriness
source:
Isabella "Bell" Cathriness, italian, NEET, (permanent indentured servant grandfathered in) to [url=https://vndb.org/c156052]Bunny[/url], who was traumatized by the harm her abusive father did towards her by destroying her left eye, and the subsequent murder of him by Bunny.

Recluse with no social life, she spends all of her time watching anime, designing cosplay, and playing video games, enabled by her ripperdoc sister who doesn't have the heart to force her sister to grow up.
